newsitem.title: USA: Household files $950 mln debt, stock shelf.
newsitem.headline: Household files $950 mln debt, stock shelf.

text.p: Household International Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $950 million in debt securities, common and preferred stock.
When combined with a previous registration, Household will have a total offering of $1.5 billion worth of securities available for sale.
Proceeds will be applied to general funds to be used to fund investments in and or extensions of credit to, to reduce other outstanding debt and to fund acquisitions, among others, the filing said.

Household Internattonal, based in Prospects Heights, Ill., is a holding company for various subsidiaries which operate in the financial services, manufacturing, transporation and merchandising industries.
